name: Frostline Gear Heated Work Gloves
description:
Insulated work gloves with resistive heating elements threaded through the fingers and palm. A micro-battery in the wrist cuff provides eight hours of continuous heat at moderate settings. The outer layer is abrasion-resistant synth-leather; the inner layer is thermal-wicking fleece.

Used by anyone working in cold environments who still needs manual dexterity — maintenance crews, delivery runners, outdoor market vendors in winter months. The heating elements are replaceable, and the gloves accept standard micro-battery swaps.
what_it_says: You work in the cold and you've spent just enough to keep your fingers functional.
story_hooks: A delivery runner's heated gloves are found with the battery drained in a building that should have been warm — suggesting they were used for something other than staying warm.

physical_description.visual_profile: Functional work gloves with a utilitarian aesthetic—fitted through the palm and fingers, slightly bulbous at the wrist where the battery module sits. The silhouette reads 'practical laborer' with a subtle tech edge.
physical_description.fit: Snug through the fingers and palm for dexterity, slightly relaxed around the wrist to accommodate the micro-battery cuff module without restricting movement.
physical_description.primary_material: Synth-leather outer (abrasion-resistant, matte finish), thermal-wicking fleece lining, resistive heating filaments threaded through structural zones.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly tacky synth-leather exterior; warm fleece interior visible at cuff. Fine raised lines visible where heating elements run through the fabric—deliberate, industrial texture.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal grey synth-leather with matte black wrist cuff module. Subtle orange accent stitching along the heating element channels. Optional high-visibility reflective piping on thumbs.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit wrist cuff with a spring-tension battery compartment; no additional fasteners. Battery swaps via a recessed slot on the inside wrist.
distinctive_features: Visible resistive heating element channels running across knuckles and fingers
Modular micro-battery cuff with LED charge indicator (faint blue glow when active)
Reinforced palm and finger pads for grip and durability
Internal thermal-wicking fleece lining that shows at the cuff
Standard micro-battery quick-swap slot (compatible with most GLMZ utility devices)
Frostline Gear branding embossed subtly on wrist module
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3—functional working-class gear. Affordable enough for regular workers but built with decent materials and genuine heating tech (not knockoff).
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by maintenance crews, delivery runners, outdoor market workers, construction teams, and anyone doing physical labor in winter. Signals someone who works outdoors in harsh conditions and can afford reliable equipment.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn and weathered with use—scuffed synth-leather, minor creasing at flex points, occasional battery residue around the wrist slot. Never pristine, always functional.
